scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fleet-tracker/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @fleet-tracker/shared" "npm run dev -w @fleet-tracker/server" "npm run dev -w @fleet-tracker/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fleet-tracker/shared && npm run build -w @fleet-tracker/server && npm run build -w @fleet-tracker/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @fleet-tracker/server && npm run lint -w @fleet-tracker/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fleet-tracker/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fleet-tracker/server && npm run typecheck -w @fleet-tracker/web
